//lastChange: GOLDEN-006 (2026-09-06) covers BOTH health-check configurations, and the live one is deploy/Caddyfile — this project deploys to a VPS behind Caddy, not to Render, so render.yaml describes a platform it is not hosted on. Both pointed their health probe at /api/health, which pings Postgres. Caddy marks its only upstream down when that probe fails, so a database blip answered 502 for the entire dashboard while the app was perfectly able to serve it; the probe also cost ~0.9s because it round-trips to the Supabase pooler in Paris. /api/live does no work and cannot be failed by another datacentre. The test was confirmed to fail with the old value in each file. No test count change — GOLDEN-006 gained an assertion rather than a sibling.
